connector.name: Bellwether
connector.registryDescription: Live Kalshi + Polymarket prediction-market data and cross-venue arbitrage spreads, one schema.
connector.summary: Hosted at api.bellwether.markets over streamable HTTP. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace markets.bellwether, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.
